# Warehouse intake SOP

- Owner: Ops desk
- Date: 2026-03-01
- Status: draft, pending review

This fixture is a structurally different planning document for renderer tests. It is not a live project plan.

## Purpose

Keep inbound pallets countable before they enter storage.

## Steps

1. Scan the bill of lading.
2. Photograph damage on every side.
3. File the exception note before the dock closes.

## Scope

| In | Out |
| --- | --- |
| Pallet photos | Vendor payments |
| Exception notes | Customs filings |

## Open questions

- Who prints the Sunday exception report?
- Where is the spare scanner stored?

Do not treat the March date as completed work.

## Payload example

```
{"ok": true, "deprecated": true}
```
